cohort: 129 pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease presenting to the largest obstetrics referral hospital in the Northern Territory, Australia over a 9.5-year period
finding: In a cohort of pregnant women with mild to severe RHD, a multidisciplinary care model was associated with low rates of maternal and fetal morbidity and no mortality.
mod_finding: Of the 28 patients who underwent an emergency cesarean section, only one was indicated for cardiac reasons.
